capabilities: Show a GitHub-style heatmap of daily word counts with clickable cells that open the corresponding daily note
Display a random list item from the vault with options to open, copy, or delete it
Collect unchecked tasks from chosen folders and mark them complete by writing [x] to the file
Configure tracked, excluded, and todo folders, daily word target, and heatmap color scheme
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation via BRAT is described as an alternative to community plugin publishing.
problem: Obsidian has no single view that shows daily writing activity, resurfaces forgotten list items, and gathers open tasks together.
summary: Sidebar view combining a daily word-count heatmap, random note rediscovery, and an unchecked-task checklist.
